testcase.name: the conditions card is absent when the state carries no conditions
in portrait fullscreen the attribution button clears the navigation bar inset
the drawer's Use current location button calls onUseCurrentLocation
fullscreen does not change the map's own measured height
a planned trip dated today is shown with a Today label in the Trip Planner section
the search bar's tap opens the manual coordinates, and Search this location shows without scrolling
the species search bar is reachable inside the search dropdown
the drawer's Trip Planner section shows a no-search message before any region is chosen
the drawer's Trip Planner section shows the trip windows card once a region is searched
entering and leaving navigation does not change the map's own measured height, in or out of fullscreen
the drawer close button closes the drawer
the Settings entry is reachable inside the Tools drawer
the conditions card reads rainfall in inches under the imperial setting
the caption keeps the true bottom edge in fullscreen while the button clears the bar
the conditions card is displayed on the seasonal tab when conditions are present
out of fullscreen the attribution button follows the navigation bar's measured height, as the caption does
search radius, month, and the location row are reachable after the bar's tap beside the expanded Advanced search, not duplicated in it
with no navigation bar inset the button in fullscreen sits at the true edge
every Trip Planner drawer control is reachable
the map slot gets a substantial share of the screen
the map slot starts at the top of the screen, not squeezed below the search bar
bottomInset is positive and identical whether or not the map is fullscreen
